title: docs(spec,adr): the action-page contract and ADR-0043 name the reject link's required reason
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBEaJzgBWzjWCNjBjkVoeRto)_

Fixes #36709

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感;只改审批"邮件一键处理链接"的接口说明和对应架构决策记录的补充说明,让它们写明驳回时必须填写理由、不填会被退回确认页。
- 为什么做:属于"审批流程"这一块;上一轮已让邮件链接驳回必须填写理由,但对外发布的接口说明和决策记录还停留在旧说法,会误导读这些文字的开发者和 AI。
- 出错会怎样:只是文字,不改任何行为;写错最多是说明不准,可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:本次含一条架构决策记录的补充说明,而该记录没有"决策/状态"小节,自动判定只能归为需要审批人合并的一档,请按该档处理。

## What changes

Text only, no behaviour change. PR #36695 made the email action-link reject require a typed reason; contract review 7101851923 on it (nit N1) found two texts still describing the old POST.

- `packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts`, the `IApprovalService.handleActionPage` docblock only:
  - `GET`: a reject link's confirm form also carries a required reason field, named `comment`.
  - `POST`: reads `token` and, for a reject link, `comment` (the last of each when a field repeats); a reject records that reason as its comment; an approve reads no `comment` and records the fixed "Via action link".
  - New bullet: a reject whose `comment` is missing, blank or not a string is refused before the token is consumed and answered the same confirm page again, carrying the refusal, with status `400` (redemption outcome `reason_required`). A dead link is judged first and still gets its `200` result page. The existing "never as an error status" sentence gains "The `400` above refuses the input, not the link."
  - `@param` / `@returns` say the same.
  Each statement is read off the implementation on `origin/main` 517e4153 (`ApprovalService.handleActionPage`, `redeemActionToken`, `actionRedemptionPage` in `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`), not off the card.
- `docs/adr/0043-actionable-approval-links.md`: one ADD-ONLY paragraph after the Non-goals list. No existing line edited or removed; the first Non-goals bullet stands as written for v1.
- `.changeset/36709-action-page-contract-reject-reason.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch. Measured, not assumed: the docblock ships. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, the new sentence "refuses the input, not the link" is found in `dist/contracts/index.d.ts` and `.d.mts`, both inside `files[]` (`dist`). Positive control: the existing "The token is the only credential" sentence is found in the same two files. So `skip-changeset` would be wrong, and `Check Changeset` needs either a changeset or that label.

Read first (by risk): (1) the new `400` bullet in the docblock, since it is the contract sentence an AI caller reads; (2) the ADR paragraph, for add-only shape; (3) the changeset.

## Tests

No behaviour moved, so no test was added and no ablation applies (docblock and ADR text).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Landing tier.** The ADR row's add-only arm cannot apply to this ADR, whatever the note says. `addOnlyNoteReasons` from `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`, run on this diff at full context, returns exactly one reason: "`docs/adr/0043-actionable-approval-links.md` names no decision or status heading, so where a note sits cannot be judged". ADR-0043's headings are TL;DR, Mechanics, Non-goals (v1) and Consequences, and its Status is a bold line, not a heading. An add-only diff cannot add such a heading to the base side, so this PR reads Tier H. The note's own lines pass every other test the reader applies (no removed line, plain-prose allowlist, no status line, no header-block line).
- Contract review N2 to N5 on PR #36695 stay outside this card, as that review placed them.
